say: ONE WAY TO THE SERVER (owner, 14 Nov, step 2, phase 1): every doPost action and its fate: general (folds into one of generalActions), special (stays its own door, and why) or dead (no caller today, kept only until a redeploy removes it). access/childRefused are ACTION_ACCESS and KID_MONEY_ACTIONS; tabs/effects are every Ledger tab and side effect the handler can reach through backend calls, so they over-say, never under-say. Read as docs/server-path.md; refreshed by node tools/server-actions.js --write; held by js/check-server-path.js.

readItems.say: Read items of one kind by id. Who may read which kind, and which fields are taken out, is permissions.json's `item` rows.

saveItem.say: Save one item of one kind (`item`), answered by the old door's own handler; who may is permissions.json's `item` rows and the old door's own gate.

deleteItem.say: Delete one item of one kind (`item`): posts and people, by the old door's own handler and gate.
